title: Majenta S Probable NDE 6217
content: I was told I looked as if I was having a seizure and as if I was really about to die. At first, everything started going black. Then I could feel I was spinning, but more of a spiral. There were tunnels, very small, but I was also going very fast. I had to choose the right one. Every time that I went the wrong way, I went faster and more tunnels appeared. I could hear voices calling my name as I went the wrong way and shouting at me. I could feel them as if they were hitting me; shouting that I was going the wrong way. It kept going as if it were never going to stop. Then, it suddenly did. Everything got quiet and peaceful. It was warm and bright. I know my discussion with this being had everything to do with my decision. I just knew I was not done living yet. I had not experienced what I need to, or achieved what I need to. I was talking to someone, but I can't remember whom, where, or what about; but we knew everything and the meaning of life. Then it just faded out and I was in a room just looking at the ceiling, shoulder to shoulder with people I did not know, yet in there I knew them. We had all gone through the same experience. I remember saying to them, 'We did it. We're here. We get to walk this earth. He gave us this and no one will ever know what it's like for us. We made it.' Just talking to them like that with the biggest, most uncontrolled smile across my face. The feeling was unimaginable. It was the happiest I have ever been. No, it was so much more than that. I can't even explain the feeling I felt but we made it. We have to live and no one can take that from us now. We are going to go out there and live like we are now meant to. We found our peace, our meaning. There are so many words I could say, but none of them could further explain it. If you've had this experience, please speak up. I know I was not alone that day. There's more of us out there, same day, same time, same after-experience.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Spinning/spiraling feeling; had to choose the right tunnel; wrong way led to going faster and more tunnels appearing; heard voices shouting and calling their name and felt as if being hit.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'being' with whom the experiencer had a discussion related to their decision to continue living; identity not remembered.

environment.environment_other_detail: Warm, bright, quiet, peaceful; later 'in a room just looking at the ceiling' with unknown-yet-known people.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Felt they were 'not done living yet' and had not experienced/achieved what they needed to.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Stated they had to live and would 'go out there and live like we are now meant to.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Reported being told they looked like they were having a seizure and about to die.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Multiple tunnels with forced choice; hostile voices/shouting and feeling hit; sudden shift to quiet peaceful warmth/brightness; later in a room shoulder-to-shoulder with unknown-yet-known people who had the same experience.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackness → spiraling/rapid tunnels with choices and shouting voices → sudden peaceful warm bright state with a being and shared 'meaning of life' knowing → room with others → experience fades out and they are looking at the ceiling.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Had to choose the correct tunnel; wrong choices increased speed and produced more tunnels; voices shouted their name and they felt as if being hit; later found themselves in a room with unknown-yet-known people who 'had all gone through the same experience' and spoke collectively about being allowed to live on Earth.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “We did it. We're here. We get to walk this earth. He gave us this and no one will ever know what it's like for us. We made it.”
